# Souls Folder

Soul files are the personality and operating context for each CherylCLAW agent. They are generated automatically when you run the onboarding skill.

**Do not edit the template files below.** They are placeholders showing structure only. Your real soul files get written here by onboarding and will replace these templates.

After onboarding runs, you CAN and SHOULD open your generated soul files and read them. If anything feels off — wrong tone, missing context, outdated information — edit the file directly. Your agents read these files on every execution, so any changes take effect immediately.

## The Souls In This Folder

- `ea-soul.md` — EA Orchestrator: who you are, how you work, what decisions it can make
- `content-soul.md` — Content Agent: your voice, your audience, your platforms
- `research-soul.md` — Research Agent: your industry, your topics, your preferred format
- `communications-soul.md` — Communications Agent: your correspondence style, your key relationships
- `outreach-soul.md` — Outreach Agent: your ideal client, your outreach style, your tools
- `meeting-soul.md` — Meeting Agent: your meeting preferences, your key contacts
- `business-intel-soul.md` — Business Intel Agent: your metrics, your data sources, your reporting preferences
- `client-onboarding-soul.md` — Client Onboarding Agent: your client journey, your onboarding assets

## Souls Are Living Documents

Update them when your business changes, you add new tools, your priorities shift, or your team changes. A soul file that is 6 months out of date is one that is giving your agents the wrong context.

Pro tip from Cheryl: Review your soul files quarterly. Treat it like a performance review for your AI team.
